incident_spec.summary: ALTER TABLE operation caused blocking due to lock contention.
symptoms: Database frozen during ALTER TABLE operation
Login system blocked due to table lock
Long-lived weak locks preventing DDL completion
incident_spec.mechanism: Lock contention caused by an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock request during ALTER TABLE, queued behind long-lived weak locks.

value.sql: ALTER TABLE cliente ADD COLUMN topicos character varying(20)[];

facts.evidence: Post includes the exact SQL statement causing the issue.
Post mentions the lock type required for ALTER TABLE.
Post explicitly states the PostgreSQL version.
Post includes the full table schema.
Post and answers hypothesize lock contention due to long-lived weak locks.

assumptions: The database environment matches PostgreSQL 9.4.5 behavior.
Synthetic data can reproduce lock contention under similar conditions.
unknowns: Whether the blocking process was idle-in-transaction or actively querying
